name.description: Name of configuration; appears in the launch configuration dropdown menu.

enumDescriptions: Start the program under the debugger.
request.description: Request type of configuration. Can be "launch" or "attach".

preLaunchTask.description: Task to run before debug session starts.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the program.

enumDescriptions: LLDB DAP (lldb-dap from Xcode or LLVM).

program.description: Path to the program to debug.

pid.description: System process ID to attach to.

waitFor.description: If set to true, then wait for the process to launch by looking for a process with a basename that matches `program`.

initCommands.description: Initialization commands executed upon debugger startup.

preRunCommands.description: Commands executed just before the program is launched.

stopCommands.description: Commands executed each time the program stops.

exitCommands.description: Commands executed when the program exits.

attachCommands.description: Custom commands that are executed instead of attaching to a process ID or to a process by name.

sourceMap.description: Source path remappings, each a [from, to] pair.

module.description: Name of the module to be debugged.

console.description: Where to launch the debug target.

justMyCode.description: If true, show and debug only user-written code. If false, show and debug all code, including library calls.

python.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used for debugging. If not specified, `python3` is used.

processId.description: The process id to attach to.

connect.description: The host and port of a debug server to attach to.

program.description: Absolute path to the program. Generated value is guessed by looking at package.json and opened files. Edit this attribute.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory of the program being debugged.

runtimeExecutable.description: Runtime to use. Either an absolute path or the name of a runtime available on the PATH. If omitted `node` is assumed.

runtimeArgs.description: Optional arguments passed to the runtime executable.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the program. The value `null` removes the variable from the environment.

skipFiles.description: An array of file or folder names, or path globs, to skip when debugging.

sourceMaps.description: Use JavaScript source maps (if they exist).

outputCapture.description: From where to capture output messages: the default debug API if set to `console`, or stdout/stderr streams if set to `std`.

port.description: Debug port to attach to. Default is 9229.

address.description: TCP/IP address of process to be debugged. Default is 'localhost'.

websocketAddress.description: Exact websocket address to attach to. If unspecified, it will be discovered from the address and port.

mode.description: One of `auto`, `debug`, `test`, `exec`, `replay`, `core` (launch), `local` or `remote` (attach). In `auto` mode, `debug` or `test` is chosen depending on the program.

program.description: Path to the program folder (or any go file within that folder) when in `debug` or `test` mode, and to the pre-built binary file to debug in `exec` mode. If it is not an absolute path, it is interpreted as a workspace relative path.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the debugged program.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the launched debuggee program.

cwd.description: Workspace relative or absolute path to the working directory of the program being debugged if a non-empty value is specified. The `program` folder is used as the working directory if `cwd` is omitted or empty.

buildFlags.description: Build flags, to be passed to the Go compiler. Maps to dlv's `--build-flags` flag.

processId.description: The ID of the process to be debugged.

host.description: When applied to remote-attach configurations, will look for "dlv ... --headless --listen=<host>:<port>" server started externally.

port.description: When applied to remote-attach configurations, will look for "dlv ... --headless --listen=<host>:<port>" server started externally.
